description: This file defines an interface 'ILocalStore' for a local storage component in a plugin architecture, specifying methods for opening, creating tables, setting limits, retrieving entries, and managing data within tables.

classes.name: ILocalStore
classes.description: An interface defining operations for local storage management, including opening storage, managing tables, entries, and limits.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens the local store at the specified path.

methods.name: CreateTable
methods.description: Creates a new table with the given name.

methods.name: SetLimit
methods.description: Sets a limit on the number of entries for a specified table.

methods.name: GetEntriesCount
methods.description: Retrieves the count of entries in a table within a range.

methods.name: GetEntries
methods.description: Retrieves entries from a table starting at a specified index.

methods.name: RemoveEntries
methods.description: Removes entries from a table within a specified range.

methods.name: AddEntry
methods.description: Adds a new entry to a specified table.
